Data.Name: Highland/Plant/ShiftId
Data.Description: Current shift number (1=00-08, 2=08-16, 3=16-24). Managed by ShiftKpiRollup.

Data.Name: Highland/Plant/TreatedVolumeTotal
Data.Description: Cumulative treated-water volume, time-integral of plant throughput. Driven by FlowTotalizer.

Data.Name: Highland/Plant/TreatedVolumeShift
Data.Description: Treated volume this shift (m3). Reset at shift change by ShiftKpiRollup.

Data.Name: Highland/Plant/EnergyTotal
Data.Description: Cumulative pump electrical energy, time-integral of motor power. Driven by EnergyMeter.

Data.Name: Highland/Plant/CoagulantConsumed
Data.Description: Cumulative coagulant (alum) dosed, time-integral of P201 dose rate. Driven by ChemicalConsumption.

Data.Name: Highland/KPI/SpecificEnergy
Data.Description: Specific energy = EnergyTotal / TreatedVolumeTotal. Efficiency KPI.

Data.Name: Highland/KPI/TurbidityCompliancePct
Data.Description: Percent of current shift with finished turbidity <= 0.3 NTU.

Data.Name: Highland/KPI/ChlorineCompliancePct
Data.Description: Percent of current shift with free chlorine residual in the 0.2-4.0 mg/L band.

Data.Name: Highland/Filtration/BackwashActiveFilter
Data.Description: Filter currently backwashing (0=none, 1-4). Enforces one-at-a-time backwash. Managed by BackwashSequencer.
